# Eagle's Roost B&B

> Self-catering guest stay in a restored late-1800s Port Master's House above the Umzimkulu River, 28 Raspberry Lane, Umtentweni, KwaZulu-Natal South Coast, South Africa. Private section of the house, two double bedrooms plus a lounge double bunk, sleeps up to 6. Five minutes from Umtentweni main beach.

Key facts:
- Address: 28 Raspberry Lane, Umtentweni, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa
- Sleeps: up to 6 guests (2 double bedrooms + lounge double bunk)
- Rates: room-only, from R950/night (low season) to R2 275/night (peak December); breakfast/lunch/supper not included
- Booking: WhatsApp +27 72 500 5179, or email bookings.eaglesroost@outlook.com
- Nearby: Umtentweni main beach and Umzimkulu River mouth (5 minutes), Sardine Run (June-July)
